title: Nighttime Nibbled Kenyan Rye Bread Flatbread
description: A delicious and easy to make flatbread featuring Kenyan rye bread and a hint of spices, perfect for snacking at midnight.

ingredients.name: Rye bread, day-old, cut into 1-inch cubes

instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
In a mortar and pestle, pound the chopped onion, garlic, and ginger until well combined.
Add the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper to the mortar and pestle, and pound until well combined.
Add the cubed rye bread to the mortar and pestle, and pound until the bread is well coated with the spice mixture.
Add the ghee or vegetable oil to the skillet or griddle, and swirl it around to coat the surface.
Add the bread mixture to the skillet or griddle, and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until the bread is golden brown and crispy.
Repeat with the remaining bread mixture, until all the bread is cooked.
Serve the flatbread hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
Enjoy your delicious Nighttime Nibbled Kenyan Rye Bread Flatbread!
Store any leftover flatbread in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 24 hours.
